strings.zh: 阿金『学习委员,{NEWLINE}我们在找几个研究员打扮的人,{CLEAR}他们刚刚应该从北面{CLEAR}慌慌张张地跑到卡吉镇来了,{CLEAR}你有看到这样的人吗？
strings.en: Gold: Class Rep, we’re looking for{NEWLINE}some people dressed as researchers.{SCROLL}They should’ve just come running into{NEWLINE}Mahogany Town from the north in a big{CLEAR}panic. Have you seen anyone like that?

strings.zh: 水晶『我刚刚带小迷蹦{NEWLINE}去精灵中心的时候,{CLEAR}确实有几个神色慌张的研究员{CLEAR}从我身边跑过。
strings.en: Crystal: When I was taking{NEWLINE}Chumee to the Pokémon Center{CLEAR}just now, some panicked-looking{CLEAR}researchers did run right past me.

strings.zh: 水晶『我当时看到他们陆续跑进了{NEWLINE}这边这家商店。
strings.en: Crystal: I saw them run into this{NEWLINE}shop over here one after another.

strings.zh: 水晶『你们这样大张旗鼓地找他们,{NEWLINE}是发生什么事了吗？
strings.en: Crystal: You’re making a big fuss{NEWLINE}looking for them. Did something happen?

strings.zh: 阿金『愤怒湖出现了奇怪的电波,{NEWLINE}我们推测是那几个人搞的鬼,{CLEAR}而且他们很可能是火箭队的成员,{CLEAR}所以我们一路从愤怒湖追查到这里。{SCROLL}阿金『多亏你注意到了他们的行踪,{NEWLINE}省去了不少找人的功夫。{CLEAR}现在我们要进这家商店继续追查。{CLEAR}你要一起来吗？
strings.en: Gold: Weird radio waves have{NEWLINE}shown up at the Lake of Rage. We{CLEAR}think those guys are behind it.{SCROLL}They’re probably Team Rocket{NEWLINE}members too, so we tracked them all{CLEAR}the way here from the Lake of Rage.{SCROLL}Gold: Thanks to you spotting them,{NEWLINE}we saved a lot of time looking.{SCROLL}Now we’re going into this shop to keep{NEWLINE}after them. Want to come with us?

strings.zh: 阿金『渡先生,柳伯馆主,{NEWLINE}学习委员是个很认真的人,{CLEAR}她说那几个人进了这边的商店{CLEAR}一般就不会有错,{CLEAR}咱们进去看看吧。
strings.en: Gold: Mr. Lance, Gym Leader Pryce,{NEWLINE}Class Rep is a really serious person.{SCROLL}If she says those guys went into{NEWLINE}this shop, she’s usually right.{CLEAR}Let’s go in and take a look.

strings.zh: 柳伯『诚如这个小姑娘所说的话,{NEWLINE}这间商店可能就是火箭队基地,{CLEAR}里面的凶险不言而喻。
strings.en: Pryce: If what this young{NEWLINE}lady says is true, this shop may{CLEAR}well be a Team Rocket base. The{CLEAR}danger inside goes without saying.

strings.zh: 渡『没错,所以在进去之前{NEWLINE}要有随时战斗的觉悟。{CLEAR}你和你的朋友可以吗？
strings.en: Lance: Right. So before we go in,{NEWLINE}be ready to fight at any moment.{CLEAR}Are you and your friend up to it?

strings.zh: 阿金『嘿嘿,我和学习委员{NEWLINE}已经与火箭队交战过很多次了,{CLEAR}你们尽管放心。
strings.en: Gold: Heh heh. Class Rep and I have{NEWLINE}fought Team Rocket plenty of times{CLEAR}already. Don’t worry about us.

strings.zh: 渡『好,那咱们进去吧。
strings.en: Lance: Good. Then let’s go in.

strings.zh: 水晶『追查火箭队吗？{NEWLINE}这种事我当然是义不容辞啦。
strings.en: Crystal: Tracking down Team Rocket?{NEWLINE}Of course I’ll help. It’s my duty.

strings.zh: 阿金『好嘞！
strings.en: Gold: You got it!

strings.zh: 靠近愤怒湖的精灵们{NEWLINE}会突然变得很痛苦,{CLEAR}是湖水被什么污染了吗？
strings.en: Pokémon that go near the Lake of{NEWLINE}Rage suddenly start suffering. Has{CLEAR}something polluted the lake water?

strings.zh: 听说是火箭队发射的电波{NEWLINE}造成了愤怒湖周围精灵的异常。{CLEAR}幸好后来有精灵联盟的训练家们{CLEAR}合力赶跑了火箭队,{CLEAR}不然后果不堪设想。
strings.en: I hear radio waves sent out by Team{NEWLINE}Rocket made the Pokémon around{CLEAR}the Lake of Rage act strangely.{SCROLL}Luckily, Trainers from the{NEWLINE}Pokémon League joined forces and drove{CLEAR}Team Rocket off. Otherwise, who{CLEAR}knows what could have happened.

strings.zh: 本来准备了一些愤怒湖的{NEWLINE}红色暴鲤龙的周边来卖,{CLEAR}结果去愤怒湖的游客们的精灵{CLEAR}纷纷出现身体异常,{CLEAR}弄得大家都不愿意买我的商品了。
strings.en: I stocked up on red Gyarados merch{NEWLINE}from the Lake of Rage to sell.{SCROLL}But then the Pokémon of tourists{NEWLINE}who went to the lake started{CLEAR}getting sick one after another, and{CLEAR}now nobody wants to buy my stuff.

strings.zh: 口袋妖怪的感官比人敏锐,{NEWLINE}如果精灵们在愤怒湖感到不舒服,{CLEAR}那一定是愤怒湖有什么{CLEAR}人们察觉不到的东西。
strings.en: Pokémon senses are sharper than{NEWLINE}ours. If Pokémon feel unwell at the{CLEAR}Lake of Rage, there must be something{CLEAR}there that people can’t detect.

strings.zh: 因为愤怒湖的红色暴鲤龙{NEWLINE}而赶来卡吉镇的游客们都散去了,{CLEAR}这里又恢复成了往日的平静小镇。
strings.en: The tourists who flocked to{NEWLINE}Mahogany Town for the Lake of{CLEAR}Rage’s red Gyarados have all{CLEAR}left. It’s back to being the{CLEAR}quiet little town it always was.

strings.zh: 柳伯馆主是远近闻名的强大训练家,{NEWLINE}我本来是想到卡吉道馆{CLEAR}拜在柳伯馆主门下学习的。{CLEAR}但是来了之后才知道{CLEAR}他老人家正在准备退休的事,{CLEAR}已经不收新弟子了。
strings.en: Pryce is a famously strong{NEWLINE}Trainer. I came to the Mahogany{CLEAR}Gym hoping to become his student.{SCROLL}But when I got here, I found out{NEWLINE}he’s preparing to retire and isn’t{CLEAR}taking new students anymore.

strings.zh: 雪童子『Snoooo——ru！
strings.en: Snorunt: Snoooo-ru!

strings.zh: 我起初是想带结草儿{NEWLINE}去愤怒湖边看红色暴鲤龙的,{CLEAR}但是结草儿越靠近愤怒湖,{CLEAR}就越发出痛苦的叫声。{CLEAR}最后我们都没有走到愤怒湖{CLEAR}就折返回来了。{SCROLL}是因为湖中红色暴鲤龙的威压,{NEWLINE}让弱小的精灵都无法靠近吗？
strings.en: At first I wanted to take Burmy to see{NEWLINE}the red Gyarados at the Lake of Rage.{SCROLL}But the closer Burmy got to the{NEWLINE}lake, the more it cried out in{CLEAR}pain. We turned back before we{CLEAR}even reached the Lake of Rage.{SCROLL}Is it the red Gyarados’s{NEWLINE}pressure that keeps weak Pokémon{CLEAR}from getting near the lake?

strings.zh: 结草儿『Buuuuu——my！
strings.en: Burmy: Buuuuu-my!

strings.zh: 他们都说靠近愤怒湖的精灵{NEWLINE}会出现痛苦的病症。{CLEAR}但我和波克基斯靠近愤怒湖后{CLEAR}什么事都没有。{CLEAR}看来很多众口一词的事{CLEAR}也未必就是真的。
strings.en: Everyone says Pokémon that go{NEWLINE}near the Lake of Rage get sick and{CLEAR}start suffering. But nothing at{CLEAR}all happened to Togekiss and me.{SCROLL}I guess just because everyone says{NEWLINE}the same thing doesn’t make it true.

strings.zh: 波克基斯『Tooooo——ge！
strings.en: Togekiss: Tooooo-ge!

strings.zh: 红色的暴鲤龙、往来的游客,{NEWLINE}这些都与我无关。{CLEAR}我来这里只是为了静心修行。{CLEAR}只有达到天人合一、物我两忘的境界,{CLEAR}才能与自己的精灵心意相通。{SCROLL}你能理解我的话吗？
strings.en: Red Gyarados, tourists coming{NEWLINE}and going... none of that{CLEAR}concerns me. I came here only{CLEAR}to train my mind in peace.{SCROLL}Only when you become one with nature{NEWLINE}and forget both self and world can your{CLEAR}heart truly connect with your Pokémon.{SCROLL}Do you understand what I mean?

strings.zh: 理解不了就在日常生活中{NEWLINE}多体会感悟吧。
strings.en: If you can’t understand it,{NEWLINE}reflect on it in your daily life.

strings.zh: 光嘴上说理解是没有用的,{NEWLINE}让我看看你是不是有真本事。
strings.en: Just saying you understand{NEWLINE}means nothing. Show me whether{CLEAR}you truly have the skill.

strings.zh: 通过战斗我能感受到{NEWLINE}你与精灵心意相通的境界{CLEAR}远远超出我的认知。{SCROLL}这个是我珍藏多年的道具,{NEWLINE}以你的水平一定能发挥它的作用,{CLEAR}请收下吧。
strings.en: Through our battle, I can feel that{NEWLINE}the bond between you and your Pokémon{CLEAR}goes far beyond anything I know.{SCROLL}This is an item I’ve treasured for many{NEWLINE}years. At your level, you’ll surely{CLEAR}put it to good use. Please take it.
strings.notes: Which item the meditating Trainer gives is not visible.

strings.zh: 你通过与精灵并肩作战这条路{NEWLINE}达到了心意想通的极致,{CLEAR}但与精灵心意想通的方式有好多种,{CLEAR}希望你在战斗之外的地方,{CLEAR}也能找到与精灵一起生活的乐趣。
strings.en: You’ve reached the peak of{NEWLINE}that bond by fighting side{CLEAR}by side with your Pokémon.{SCROLL}But there are many ways to{NEWLINE}connect with Pokémon. I hope you’ll{CLEAR}also find the joy of living with{CLEAR}your Pokémon outside of battle.

strings.en: Girafarig: Giiii-ra!

strings.zh: 听说愤怒湖出现了红色的暴鲤龙,{NEWLINE}真想近距离看看它那{CLEAR}漂亮的红色鳞片啊。
strings.en: I hear a red Gyarados has appeared{NEWLINE}at the Lake of Rage. I’d love to see{CLEAR}its beautiful red scales up close.

strings.zh: 哎？要送给我暴鲤龙的红色鳞片？{NEWLINE}这么贵重的东西,{CLEAR}这……我……{CLEAR}真的是太感谢了！{SCROLL}谢谢你送给我红色鳞片,{NEWLINE}我不能白拿你的东西。{CLEAR}正好我的精灵{CLEAR}最近学会了一招喷水,{CLEAR}如果你的精灵也想学的话,{CLEAR}随时可以来找我。
strings.en: Huh? You’re giving me a Gyarados’s{NEWLINE}Red Scale? Something this{CLEAR}precious... I... Thank you so much!{SCROLL}Thanks for the Red Scale. I{NEWLINE}can’t take it for nothing.{SCROLL}My Pokémon just learned Water{NEWLINE}Spout. If yours want to learn{CLEAR}it too, come see me anytime.
